author: musho7-dev
subject: First-launch TAP TO DRIVE, 3-step tutorial, coin icon, flying coins, record celebrations
body:
- Brand-new players see only the title and a big pulsing TAP TO DRIVE
  (Buggy on Dust Mesa); the garage opens after the first run
- First-run tutorial tips that never block the screen: "Hold GAS to
  drive" (GAS pedal pulses), "In the air: GAS leans back, BRAKE leans
  forward" on the first jump (both pedals pulse), "Never land on your
  head!"; shown once
- Gold coin icon (drawn in code) replaces "c" in the HUD, upgrade
  prices and the roadside-help button
- Collected coins fly to the HUD counter, which pops
- Passing your best mid-run: NEW RECORD! popup, fanfare, confetti and
  haptics; results screen counts distance and coins up, bounces the
  NEW BEST badge and throws confetti
